title: SBI Tata Croma Select credit card

cardOverview.overviewText: The Tata Croma Card Select is a premium co-branded credit card from Tata and SBI, tailored for Croma and Tata brand shoppers. It offers up to 5% value back at Tata outlets, 2% on Croma purchases, and 3X rewards on dining, grocery, and international spends. With a ₹2,999 annual fee, it includes a ₹3,000 welcome voucher and 8 complimentary domestic lounge visits each year ideal for tech-savvy Tata loyalists.
